title: 3rd Truth 1st Mystery No Degrees In Essential Power

questions.question: What is the main idea of the First Mystery?
questions.answer: Allah’s power has no weakness and no limits.

questions.question: What cannot enter something if it truly belongs to its very nature?
questions.answer: Its opposite cannot enter it.

questions.question: What is the opposite of power in this passage?
questions.answer: Weakness.

questions.question: Why can weakness never reach Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Because His power belongs to His own Essence.

questions.question: What does the passage say causes different levels in something?
questions.answer: The mixing in of its opposite.

questions.question: What makes some light brighter and some light dimmer in the example?
questions.answer: Darkness.

questions.question: What makes heat seem higher or lower in the example?
questions.answer: Cold.

questions.question: What makes strength seem greater or less in the example?
questions.answer: Resistance.

questions.question: Are there different levels in Allah’s power like strong and weak?
questions.answer: No. His power has no levels.

questions.question: How does Allah create all things, according to the passage?
questions.answer: As easily as creating one thing.

questions.question: What cannot block Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Nothing can block it.

questions.question: Which is harder for Allah: bringing the big rising after death, making spring, growing a tree, or making a flower?
questions.answer: None is harder. They are all easy for Him.

questions.question: How does the passage compare a flower and a tree in beauty and skill?
questions.answer: A flower is made with skill, just like a tree.

questions.question: What would happen to making living things if Divine unity were denied?
questions.answer: Creation would become very hard and lose its beauty and value.

questions.question: What do fruits, flowers, trees, and animals do after they come into the world?
questions.answer: They do their jobs, praise Allah, and leave seeds behind.

questions.question: What is being explained in the First Mystery?
questions.answer: Why Allah can create everything with ease.

questions.question: If a thing is truly part of what something is, can its opposite be inside it too?
questions.answer: No, it cannot.

questions.question: What impossible thing would happen if two opposites were together in the same way?
questions.answer: An impossible joining of opposites.

questions.question: Since Allah is All-Powerful, what opposite can never touch Him?
questions.answer: Powerlessness.

questions.question: What lesson do the examples of light, heat, and strength teach?
questions.answer: Differences happen when an opposite gets mixed in.

questions.question: Why are there no bigger and smaller levels in Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Because no weakness enters it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about difficulty for Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Nothing is difficult for Him.

questions.question: How easy is the final rising after death for Allah compared with spring?
questions.answer: It is just as easy.

questions.question: How easy is spring for Allah compared with making a tree?
questions.answer: It is just as easy.

questions.question: How easy is making a tree for Allah compared with making a flower?
questions.answer: It is just as easy.

questions.question: Does the passage say Allah makes only small things beautifully, or both small and great things beautifully?
questions.answer: He makes both small and great things beautifully.

questions.question: What does the passage say people can see with their own eyes?
questions.answer: Allah makes these things happen in front of us.

questions.question: If there were no Divine unity, what might happen to a living thing that now appears quickly?
questions.answer: It might take a very long time or never appear.

questions.question: Even though fruits and animals are many, how does the passage describe them?
questions.answer: They are still precious and well-made.

questions.question: What is left behind after these living things go on?
questions.answer: Their seeds.

questions.question: What does the First Mystery teach about Allah’s power and weakness?
questions.answer: Weakness cannot be part of Allah’s power.

questions.question: Why is it wrong to think both a thing and its opposite are together in the same way?
questions.answer: Because that is impossible.

questions.question: What is one example showing that opposite things can change a level?
questions.answer: Darkness can make light less bright.

questions.question: What is another example showing that opposite things can change a level?
questions.answer: Cold can lower heat.

questions.question: What is a third example showing that opposite things can change a level?
questions.answer: Resistance can lessen strength.

questions.question: What do these examples help us understand about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: His power has no weak level in it.

questions.question: Since Allah’s power has no weak side, what can stop it?
questions.answer: Nothing can stop it.

questions.question: Which is easier for Allah: one flower or the great rising after death?
questions.answer: Both are equally easy for Him.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the way Allah makes a flower, a tree, spring, and resurrection?
questions.answer: He makes all of them with perfect skill and wonder.

questions.question: What belief is said to make creation easy and full of beauty?
questions.answer: Belief in Divine unity.

questions.question: Without Divine unity, how would making a flower compare to making a tree?
questions.answer: It would be just as hard or even harder.

questions.question: Without Divine unity, how would making a tree compare to making spring?
questions.answer: It would be just as hard or even harder.

questions.question: What would creation lose if Divine unity were denied?
questions.answer: Its worth and fine art.

questions.question: What do living things do before they leave this world, according to the passage?
questions.answer: They carry out their duties and glorify Allah.

questions.question: What truth about Allah is the First Mystery trying to show?
questions.answer: Allah’s power is perfect and complete.

questions.question: What can never enter the very nature of a thing?
questions.answer: Its opposite.

questions.question: In this passage, what is opposite to power?
questions.answer: Impotence, or weakness.

questions.question: Why does the passage say this opposite cannot reach Allah?
questions.answer: Because His power is tied to His Sacred Essence.

questions.question: Where do levels like more and less usually come from?
questions.answer: From the effect of an opposite.

questions.question: What opposite affects light in the example?
questions.answer: Darkness.

questions.question: What opposite affects heat in the example?
questions.answer: Coldness.

questions.question: What opposite affects strength in the example?
questions.answer: Resistance.

questions.question: What does this mean about Allah’s power having levels?
questions.answer: It does not have levels.

questions.question: How does Allah deal with many things compared with one thing?
questions.answer: He creates many as easily as one.

questions.question: Why can no obstacle stand in the way of Allah’s creating?
questions.answer: Because His power has no weakness or shortage.

questions.question: Name two things the passage says are equally easy for Allah.
questions.answer: Resurrection and spring.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the way Allah makes a flower compared with a tree?
questions.answer: Both are made with great art.

questions.question: If Divine unity were not true, how would making one living thing change?
questions.answer: It would become very difficult.

questions.question: What shows that living things continue after they leave?
questions.answer: They leave their seeds behind.

questions.question: What is the first big point taught in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s power can never include weakness.

questions.question: What rule does the passage give about a thing and its opposite?
questions.answer: They cannot both belong to the same essence in that way.

questions.question: Why would that be impossible?
questions.answer: Because opposites cannot truly join like that.

questions.question: Since Allah’s power belongs to His Essence, what can never touch it?
questions.answer: Weakness can never touch it.

questions.question: What happens when an opposite mixes into something, according to the examples?
questions.answer: Different levels appear.

questions.question: How do we see this with light?
questions.answer: Darkness makes it seem stronger or weaker.

questions.question: How do we see this with heat?
questions.answer: Cold changes its level.

questions.question: How do we see this with strength?
questions.answer: Resistance changes how strong it is.

questions.question: What does the passage want us to understand from these examples?
questions.answer: Allah’s power has no levels and no weakness.

questions.question: How easy is making spring for Allah compared with making a tree?
questions.answer: It is equally easy.

questions.question: How easy is making a tree for Allah compared with making a flower?
questions.answer: It is equally easy.

questions.question: What can we learn from the words that these things happen before our eyes?
questions.answer: We can see signs of Allah’s power all around us.

questions.question: What would happen to the beauty and worth of created things without Divine unity?
questions.answer: Their beauty and worth would be lost.

questions.question: What do many valuable living things do in an orderly way?
questions.answer: They come, do their work, praise Allah, and leave seeds.

questions.question: What is the title of the part we are learning from?
questions.answer: The First Mystery.

questions.question: What opposite of power is named in the passage?
questions.answer: Impotence, or weakness.

questions.question: What does the passage say about opposites and a thing’s true essence?
questions.answer: The opposite cannot enter it.

questions.question: Why is Allah’s power free from weakness?
questions.answer: Because it is essential to His own Essence.

questions.question: According to the passage, what brings about degrees in things?
questions.answer: The presence of the opposite.

questions.question: What example is given for light having different degrees?
questions.answer: Darkness changes it.

questions.question: What example is given for heat having different degrees?
questions.answer: Cold changes it.

questions.question: What example is given for strength having different degrees?
questions.answer: Resistance changes it.

questions.question: What follows from the fact that Allah’s power has no degrees?
questions.answer: Nothing can make His creating difficult.

questions.question: What kinds of problems can never get in the way of Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Obstacles, weakness, and deficiency.

questions.question: How does the passage compare the ease of resurrection, spring, a tree, and a flower?
questions.answer: They are all equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: Does the passage describe only resurrection as wondrous, or other things too?
questions.answer: Other things too, like spring, trees, and flowers.

questions.question: What does the passage say would be harder without Divine unity: making a flower, a tree, and spring, or making them with Divine unity?
questions.answer: Without Divine unity, they would be much harder.

questions.question: How fast might one living thing be made without Divine unity?
questions.answer: It could take a year or perhaps never be made.

questions.question: Why do fruits, flowers, trees, and animals appear in an ordered way, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because of this mystery of Allah’s easy and perfect power.
